kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-connection-pools --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-ids cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-name pool01 --connection-pool-status Running --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnectionPools

parameters.help_en: A list of connection address pool IDs. You can specify up to 20 connection address pool IDs
parameters.help_zh: 连接地址池的ID列表。最多支持传入20个连接地址池ID
parameters.name: connection_pool_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the connection address pool. You can specify up to 20 connection address pool names.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池的名称。最多支持传入20个连接地址池名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: connection_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the connection address pool. You can specify up to 20 connection address pool statuses.
Creating: Creation in progress.
Running: Running.
Deleting: Deletion in progress.
Deleted: Deleted.
Associating: IP attaching in progress.
Dissociating: IP detaching in progress
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池的状态。最多支持传入20个连接地址池状态。
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除。
Associating：IP绑定中。
Dissociating：IP解绑中
parameters.name: connection_pool_status

parameters.help_en:
A token used to mark the starting position for the current read operation. An empty value indicates reading from the beginning.

You do not need to specify this parameter in the first call. The response will include a NextToken for the next call. Each subsequent response will contain the NextToken for the following call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to read in this request. Valid values: 1 to 50. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，取值：1~50。传入为空时，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cloud connector instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id
